title: Igihugu c'Ukwisubirako
intro: Mu bitabu vy’ivya kera vy’ubutoni bw’Imana, hariho umutima w’ubugororotsi butagira uko bungana, ushizwe ku ruhande rw’abantu babo kugira ngo urondere ubwiherero mu nzira nyeranda. Ntibari bazi ko ukwo kwiherera kwozana ikimenyetso ku isi zose, ikigeragezo c’ukwizera covugwa ibihe bidahera.
clues: Narihebeye ubuzima bwo gukorera imbere y’uko mvuka.
Nari ntunganijwe n’ibifungurwa bivuye kuri Allah vyatangaje umucungerezi wanje.
Naciye nva mu muryango wanje nja mu kibanza co mu buseruko.
Umumarayika yarambonekeye afise ishusho y’umuntu atunganye, azana inkuru y’umwana atyoroye.
Maze kugaruka n’umwana wanje aherutse kuvuka, abantu banje barandega, ariko uruyoya rwaravuze rwo kwiregura.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
